description: Eight logic outputs carrying the bits of a number you dial up on one knob.

params.text: Sets the number the eight outputs carry, 0 to 255; the display shows it as two hexadecimal digits.

outputs.text: The least significant bit of the number, high for every odd value.
The second bit of the number, worth two.
The third bit of the number, worth four.
The fourth bit of the number, worth eight.
The fifth bit of the number, worth sixteen.
The sixth bit of the number, worth thirty-two.
The seventh bit of the number, worth sixty-four.
The most significant bit of the number, worth one hundred and twenty-eight.

notes: A logic output is 10V for high and 0V for low.
The knob covers 0 to 255 over its travel, so a small turn moves several counts. Type a value into the knob's own tooltip to set one exactly.
